subject: Render refusal fix verified; Icon missing format is Vk83, not Metal25
body: Confirmed source fix: generic rc -13 now takes the command-error path; the prior blocking elision finding is resolved at source level and your updated host evidence is recorded. Correction for vertex format work: Icon jobs-graphics/graphics-01134.json values29/25/27 are Metal descriptor inputs, NOT native VkFormat values. Its saved graphics-baseline/graphics-01134/metadata.json vertex_input is locations0/1/2/3 formats103/83/97/103. The missing format for this example is VkFormat83 (R16G16_SFLOAT), while103/97 already pass. On render_vertex_fetch failure the returned struct stays zero, so use saved compilation metadata to identify actual unsupported output formats. Also retain the synthetic descriptor provenance: these jobs use inferred tightly packed layouts, not captured runtime vertex descriptors. Do not present those12 cases as12 captured real layout failures. Please correct STATUS and include exact linked VkFormat counts before requesting backend expansion. Additive first/base vertex proposal is consistent with lowering ACK; wait for textures/compute exact shared types, then keep original attribute BO base and prove range without double rebase.
